==Biography==
Goku joined [[KaBuM! Black]] in December 2014, replacing the opening left by [[Shadow (Lee Min-ho)|Shadow]] returning to Korea. He played with them until May 2015.<ref>[http://clickandview.com.br/guko-e-dispensado-da-kabum-black/ Guko é dispensado da Kabum Black] ''clickandview.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Often remembered for his {{ci|orianna}} pentakill when he played for [[ProGaming Esports]] in the [[CBLOL 2018 Split 1 Playoffs|playoffs series in 2018]] against [[CNB e-Sports Club]].
* He had considered retiring from the competitive scene in 2023 to play poker professionally, but returned to play for [[Flamengo Esports]] in [[MEG 2023]].<ref>[https://maisesports.com.br/lol-goku-anuncia-saida-do-cenario-e-migrara-para-o-poker/ LoL: Goku anuncia saída do cenário e migrará para o Poker (Portuguese)]''maisesports.com.br''</ref>
** He eventually moved to the US to study and play for [[Weber State University]].
